note: openworld/PLAN-SITES.md section 2. A site is one settlement of the scale model (its id in tools/scale-model/model/src/60-settlements.js, on the 5.1 canvas) and its hinterland; a region is the cut that holds one or more sites (tools/scale-model/cut_site.py <region>). reach_km is the half-size of a site's square (city 30, village 15, outpost or camp 8 by default); polygons are regions of the model (by id) that join the cut; corridors are strips width_km wide between two of the region's sites (so the roads between them have ground). state: planned | cut | built.

pinnacle.name: Pinnacle Rock
pinnacle.note: the first site (the owner, 2026-11-09): the town on its mesa stays settlements/pinnacle-rock's own; the site holds its countryside, bands and roads planned on the world's ground

xanadu-oidong-highrift.name: Xanadu, Oidong and the High Rift
xanadu-oidong-highrift.note: the owner, 2026-11-09: one region over the Xanadu Sultanate (political), the Oidong Valley and the High Rift (biomes); about 1,740 x 540 km, so the sub-continental cut (1 km cells)

iziz-cluster.name: The Iziz cluster
iziz-cluster.note: the owner, 2026-11-09: Girder, Mav's Refuge and Talia as three sites in one region, with the roads between them

oidong-highrift.name: The Oidong Valley and the High Rift
oidong-highrift.note: the owner, 2026-11-11 (core/simulation/PROPOSAL-LONGSONG-PINNACLE.md section 6): Longsong moves onto the open world's ground, cut from the Oidong Valley and the High Rift out of the xanadu-oidong-highrift region; the Singing Gjar outpost and its two work camps, and the Order's two accessory houses (the owner: 'one or two other accessory monasteries in places that look strategic or very productive'). The two polygons hold the Mirror Graben and the beck road whole, so the outpost's grain trade stays inside the cut

sfgtxw10kr.name: Strongbow

Not on the scale model's list yet: add it to model/src/60-settlements.js after the Qiblai move lands
